notes: Eight own pages attempted. investors.servicetitan.com failed with a network timeout (no snapshot) and was not retried; the ownership claim (C24) was settled from the press page instead, so no claim depends on it. The other seven pages answered HTTP 200 and are not thin. The pricing page names three packages (Starter, Essentials, The Works) with Request Pricing and no dollar amounts, so every dollar figure (C03 to C16) is unverifiable. Its text snapshot lists the same feature names under every package (inclusion is shown by icons that the text does not carry), so only claims about the top package (The Works) were classed from it. C20 (no public tiers) is left unverifiable because the line is ambiguous between packages (public) and price points (not public). C23 (Pro products are add-ons) rests on the site's own wording Upgrade to Pro Products and Get more with Pro. Phones Pro (C34) is not on the current Pro list, which shows Contact Center Pro; no rename is documented on a page read, so it is unverifiable rather than stale. Hedged lines (pricing may range from $259, base packages can start around $398, fees that can range) were not coded. NFPA compliance check marks in Claude's fire-protection tables were treated as feature support, not certification claims. Capterra ratings, sentiment scores and data-export complaints are out of scope. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor; investors.servicetitan.com still has no snapshot, but no claim depends on it. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing. Completeness: nine instances added to existing claims (C13, C14, C23, C25, C30, C32), mostly from the FieldEdge comparison sections and feature tables, and three unverifiable claims added (C36 the five-technician monthly cost, C37 a 12-month minimum contract, C38 inventory management as an add-on). The QuickBooks rows that mark ServiceTitan as Limited or Average were taken as stating that the integration exists (C25); the quality judgement itself is out of scope.
